instruction: Turn on the 'Send a Do Not Track request' option in Chrome's privacy settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to Chrome settings > Search engine section and changed default search engine from Google to Microsoft Bing in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome settings, navigate to specific settings sections, use dialogs/dropdowns to change setting values
metadata.task_rationale: Tests settings-navigation capability in Privacy and security section with a boolean toggle instead of a dropdown selection
metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling Do Not Track in Chrome privacy settings. Uses official enable_do_not_track getter which returns string 'true'/'false'. Custom metric check_do_not_track__7317fcab converts string result to boolean before comparing against expected enabled state. Postconfig restarts Chrome to persist settings. [Fixed: type mismatch - getter returns string but metric compared against boolean]
fix_history: Fix 1: Fixed type mismatch in check_do_not_track metric - getter returns string 'true'/'false' but metric compared against boolean True. Added string-to-boolean conversion before comparison.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_enable_do_not_track) correctly reads the 'enable_do_not_track' key from Chrome's Preferences JSON file and returns 'true'/'false' as a string — this is the right state for the instruction.

Metric correctly handles the string-to-boolean type conversion: checks isinstance(result, str) and converts via result.lower() == 'true' before comparing against the boolean expected value. The previous type mismatch has been fixed.
Expected parameter handling is correct: with expected.type='rule', the metric receives {'enabled': true} directly, and expected.get('enabled', True) correctly extracts the boolean value.
Postconfig correctly kills and restarts Chrome with a 3-second sleep, ensuring the Preferences file is persisted to disk before the getter reads it.
Full instruction coverage: the single requirement (turn on Do Not Track) is fully verified by checking the enable_do_not_track preference value.
